free_tier.stated: 5 GB per account; up to 25 repositories, public or private

egress.terms: No metered egress stated for Commons; instance is 'One shared box on Hetzner ... behind Cloudflare'. Free tier described as permanent, no trial clock.

tooling: Forgejo API, git over HTTPS and SSH, webhooks. Git LFS explicitly NOT enabled (removes one storage pool).
chaining: Provides 5 GB storage per registered account, requiring independent Fjord user registrations for each allocation.
limits_note: 25 repos/account; 5 GB; LFS disabled; CI 2000 minutes/month pooled across ALL of Commons, 20 min/job; CI on public repos only.

identity_cost.detail: the Fjord account registration form asks for an email address and a password (minimum 8 characters) and shows a Cloudflare Turnstile widget; no card or phone field is shown

reliability_note: Explicitly shared infrastructure on a single Hetzner box with nightly backups described as DR-only, not per-account restore. Community support only.

evidence.proved: 'Repositories Up to 25 repositories ... Storage 5 GB per account; Git LFS is not enabled'; 'It is free because it is shared, and it stays free' (not a trial)
